source.detail: Official documented example, transcribed verbatim from the OceanBase Oracle-mode EXPLAIN reference (OceanBase V4.3.5). It is a published documentation sample, not a capture from a local OceanBase instance: it was never executed here, and capturedAt records when it was transcribed from the documentation page. The payload is the documented JSON document with its original key order and values; the documentation renders it inside a result table, so only that table formatting was removed.
